source.document: Princeton ISD Green Cord Community Service Program Handbook
source.note: Every value below is quoted or derived directly from the handbook page cited in its `page` field. Anything the handbook does not state is recorded as "unspecified".

annualReset.quote: The Green Cord Program operates on an annual basis. Service hours do not carry over from one school year to the next.

earliestAccrualDate.quote: Students may begin earning hours for the upcoming school year on June 1 preceding that academic year.

enrollmentDeadline.quote: Students must complete all enrollment requirements no later than October 1 of the school year they first join to be eligible for Green Cord recognition during that academic year.

membershipFeeUSD.quote: A one-time membership fee of $20.00 is required upon enrollment in the Princeton ISD Green Cord Community Service Program. Payable through RevTrak.

fourYearTotalHours.quote: If a student completes all four years they would complete a total of 250 hours.

thresholdHours.quote: Freshman Service Certificate Minimum 25 cumulative verified service hours

submissionDeadline.quote: Freshman, Sophomore, and Junior Recognition April 15 annually

thresholdHours.quote: Sophomore Service Certificate Minimum 50 cumulative verified service hours

submissionDeadline.quote: Freshman, Sophomore, and Junior Recognition April 15 annually

thresholdHours.quote: Junior Service Certificate Minimum 75 cumulative verified service hours

submissionDeadline.quote: Freshman, Sophomore, and Junior Recognition April 15 annually

thresholdHours.quote: Senior Green Cord Award Minimum 100 cumulative verified service hours

submissionDeadline.quote: All community service hours must be completed and submitted through the Green Cord Google Form no later than April 1 of the student's senior year.

value: Faith based instruction received by the student
excluded.quote: The following activities do not qualify

maxHours.note: The handbook states per-category maximums only for School-Based Service and Faith Based Organizations, plus a Single Organization Limit. It states no overall cap for other community service.

value: Service projects sponsored by nonprofit organizations

minimumDistinctOrganizationsSeniorYear.quote: Students must complete service through at least three separate organizations before qualifying for the Green Cord Award during their Senior Year.

seniorDistinctionLevels.name: Silver Service Distinction
seniorDistinctionLevels.quote: Silver Service Distinction (Green and White Cord) 150-199 Hours

seniorDistinctionLevels.name: Gold Service Distinction
seniorDistinctionLevels.quote: Gold Service Distinction (Green and Yellow Cord) 200+ Hours

requiredFields.quote: All service hours must be documented using the Princeton ISD Community Service Verification Form.

value: Additional disciplinary action as determined by school administration

familyMayNotVerify.quote: Parents may not verify their own student's service hours.

value: Babysitting for individuals or family members
Activities completed solely for a grade
Community service for truancy or probation requirements

checklist.title: Complete the Green Cord Membership Application
Submit the Parent & Student Acknowledgement Form
Pay the one-time $20 Green Cord Membership Fee
Join the Green Cord Google Classroom
Complete all enrollment requirements by October 1
Serve at least three separate organizations before the Green Cord Award

unspecified.reason: The handbook sets maximums for School-Based Service (60), Faith Based Organizations (40) and any Single Organization (40). It sets no cap for community service generally.
The three-organization requirement is stated only for the Senior Year Green Cord Award. The handbook states no distinct-organization minimum for grades 9, 10 or 11.
